preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 5 for x in stdin.split()[0:1]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 20 for x in stdin.split()[1:2])
preconditions.description: The first two integers in stdin are n (1 ≤ n ≤ 5) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 20), representing the number of rows and columns, respectively.
The input contains exactly n + m + 2 integers: n, m, followed by n row segment counts and m column segment counts.

preconditions.expression: all(int(x) >= 0 for x in stdin.split()[2:2 + int(stdin.split()[0])]) and all(int(x) >= 0 for x in stdin.split()[2 + int(stdin.split()[0]):])
preconditions.description: All row and column segment counts are non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.count('\n') == int(stdin.split()[0]) and all(len(line) == int(stdin.split()[1]) for line in stdout.split('\n'))
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly n lines, each containing exactly m characters (either '.' or '*').

postconditions.expression: all(any(line.count('*') > 0 for line in stdout.split('\n')) or line.count('*') == 0 for line in stdout.split('\n'))
postconditions.description: Each row in the output has at least one contiguous black segment if its segment count is > 0, or no black cells if its segment count is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(any('*' in line and line.count('*') > 0 for line in stdout.split('\n')) or line.count('*') == 0 for line in stdout.split('\n'))
postconditions.description: Each row's black cells form exactly the number of contiguous segments specified in the input (ai for the i-th row).

postconditions.expression: all(any('*' in ''.join([line[j] for line in stdout.split('\n')])) for j in range(int(stdin.split()[1])))
postconditions.description: Each column in the output has at least one contiguous black segment if its segment count is > 0.
